# Where I've Traveled

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
if (!requireNamespace("leaflet", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::asis_output(
    "<p><em>Install <code>leaflet</code> to see the interactive map: <code>install.packages(\"leaflet\")</code></em></p>"
  )
} else {
  library(leaflet)
  lng <- c(
    -104.9903,
    -105.5217,
    -105.2705,
    -105.0844,
    -104.7091,
    -105.2211,
    -106.0444
  )
  lat <- c(
    39.7392,
    40.3783,
    40.0150,
    40.5853,
    40.4233,
    39.7555,
    39.6303
  )
  popup <- c(
    "<b>Colorado Air Quality Index</b><br><a href='https://github.com/linarettig/Colorado-Air-Quality-Index' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>Colorado-Air-Quality-Index</a>",
    "<b>National Park Visitation &amp; Air Quality</b><br><a href='https://github.com/linarettig/r_finalproject' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>r_finalproject</a>",
    "<b>Geospatial</b><br><a href='https://github.com/linarettig/Geospatial' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>Geospatial</a>",
    "<b>Debugging &amp; AI</b><br><a href='https://github.com/linarettig/Debugging-AI' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>Debugging-AI</a>",
    "<b>APIs, Functions &amp; Iteration</b><br><a href='https://github.com/linarettig/APIs-Functions-Iteration' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>APIs-Functions-Iteration</a>",
    "<b>Nesting &amp; Modeling</b><br><a href='https://github.com/linarettig/Nested-Modeling' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>Nested-Modeling</a>",
    "<b>H₂O Dashboard</b><br><a href='https://github.com/linarettig/h2o-dashdboard' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>h2o-dashdboard</a>"
  )
  leaflet::leaflet() |>
    leaflet::addTiles() |>
    leaflet::addMarkers(lng = lng, lat = lat, popup = popup)
}
```
